links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM SCORE2 numeric risk computation versus guideline calculation
links.effect: Mean absolute error exceeded 5 percentage points in all but one of eleven LLMs; ten of eleven systematically underestimated risk.
links.quote: LLMs struggled with SCORE2 numeric computation, with mean absolute error exceeding 5 percentage points in all but one.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating eleven LLMs on clinical vignettes for cardiovascular risk stratification and guideline compliance without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
